title: Genesis Germany - Electrified G80 charging page
notes: Current (facelift, 94.5 kWh) page: "Battery conditioning mode ensures that your battery is at the ideal charging temperature for the weather"; 10-80 % in 25 min. Does not say how the mode is started, and describes the facelift car, not the 87.2 kWh 2023-2025 car.
